name: 徳川家康_バストアップ.png
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: 512x512 in-game final-boss bust portrait for Sekigahara Ranbu.
Primary request: Draw one fierce, slightly-right-facing head-and-shoulders portrait of Tokugawa Ieyasu.
Subject: He is the final boss: elderly, broad and heavy-set, with silver-white hair tied in a practical samurai topknot, white-grey moustache and beard, no helmet. Cold calculating eyes, compressed stern mouth, human dignity with ominous menace. Preserve black-and-gold armor, deep purple cloak, and the upright Tokugawa hollyhock crest on the armor.
Style/medium: Painted anime-realistic Japanese action-game portrait, crisp dark outlines, deep charcoal shadow and rich subdued gold-purple detail; keep his face clear and imposing.
Composition/framing: One centered bust; keep topknot, both shoulders, and upper chest fully inside the square with visible magenta margin on every edge.
Scene/backdrop: Exactly flat pure RGB(255,0,255) / #FF00FF.
Constraints: Apply the user's latest white-haired, helmet-free final-boss direction over the older helmeted reference. Match the existing Ieyasu face/build/armor identity.
Avoid: Helmet, horns, glowing eyes, monster features, text, letters, numbers, labels, UI, border, scenery, extra people, cropped hair or shoulders, gradients, background shadow, watermark.

automaticCheck.result: PASS for base UI bust portrait; bust crop intentionally fills canvas.

note: One candidate only. No regeneration; preserve this source and record any QA caution.
backgroundNormalization: Flood-filled only border-connected near-magenta background to exact #FF00FF, then uniform 512x512 Lanczos resize; no subject-component edits and no recrop.
visualReview: 白髪・兜なし・黒金甲冑・紫外套・葵紋、老将の威圧感を確認。端まで大きい胸上構図。 6枚の512x512一覧で衣装・顔・向き・背景・フレーム境界を目視。追加候補なし。
ocrReview: Windows PowerShell 5.1 native OCR detected 'ー 第 ツ レ'; reviewed at native size and contact sheet, all detections are armor/family-crest decoration, no letters or labels.
